mapper.sql: select id, user_id, type_value, title, link_url, picture_url, note, tags, status, progress, pinned, share, share_time, create_time, update_time from other_collection
mapper.select: where user_id = #{userId} order by pinned desc, create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into other_collection (id, user_id, type_value, title, link_url, picture_url, note, tags, status, progress, pinned, share, share_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{typeValue}, #{title}, #{linkUrl}, #{pictureUrl}, #{note}, #{tags}, #{status}, #{progress}, #{pinned}, #{share}, #{shareTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.delete: delete from other_collection where user_id = #{userId} and type_value = #{typeValue}
